result.topic_en: A second high-precision computation of a constant A: 59·10^9·A is factored into primes and its logarithm is evaluated with Wolfram's logarithm table, giving A to about 50 decimals and a check on the table's logarithms.

methods.what: Prime factorization of the leading digits of 59·10^9·A
Factoring 3631939 by finding two distinct representations by the binary quadratic form 40x^2+19y^2
methods.quote:
Die Zahl 3631939 zerfiel in die Factoren $1091 \times 3329$
(welche aus $3\,631939 = 40.232^2 + 19.279^2 = 40.300^2 + 19.41^2$)
gefunden waren)

methods.what: Writing the quantity as an approximation times an exponential correction, with the correction exponent computed from tabulated logarithms
Evaluation of e^δ by splitting off a logarithm term and using a truncated exponential series
Verification of logarithm table entries through agreement of two independent computations
methods.quote:
Zugleich kann man aus der Übereinstimmung beider
der Rechnungen schließen, daß die Logarithmen von
2, 3, 5, 11, 13, 59, 67, 1091, 2281, 3329 in der Wolfram-
schen Tafel bis auf die letzte Figur richtig sind.

items.quote:

items.english: At the same time one can conclude from the agreement of the two calculations that the logarithms of 2, 3, 5, 11, 13, 59, 67, 1091, 2281, 3329 in Wolfram's table are correct up to the last figure.
